text: Figo's Manor
Lost Town
Man
Pelulu
Rieno
Balsette
Guard's Voice
Cannot go to another map now.
Wait. Don't go beyond this point.\nPlease turn back.
Are you the leader of the fortress?
But you look... scraggy.
Ha ha, you don't mince your words.\nI'm just a wanderer staying here for free.\nNot even a soldier. The leader Rieno is...
No! Monsters!!
Rienooo!!
Ug... I'm alright...
Gwah!!
You hear the sound of weapons clashing and\nhorrible monster roar from afar!
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat All the Gob Rogas!!
Thanks for helping me. So, you are an adventurer.\nI thought you were a member of the Cule caravan...\nExcuse me.
Thanks, Balsette...
Please lie down and have a rest...
Oh, sorry for not introducing myself.\nI'm Balsette. As I said, I'm a wanderer.
I was starving on my way but Rieno saved my life.\nSince then, I'm fighting the monsters here\nwith the soldiers. But...
Monsters are increasing day by day.\nWhat is worse, the soldiers, including Rieno,\nare poisoned by the monsters...
For now, it's not life-threatening but they can't\nfight like before...
Me? I might have developed immunity against poison\nbecause I've run into so many kinds\nwhile traveling...
We have to remove the poison from their bodies...\nAnd we need special holy gems to do that.
I guess Resistle people can create the holy gems.
But lots of monsters are lurking outside, so\nI can't just go and leave the sick soldiers here.
But if I don't act now,\nwe'll be done sooner or later...
So, I'd like you to go get the holy gems to remove\nthe poison. Could you do that for us?
Hey! Don't tell me you're gonna accept this!
How long do you think it would take to go back to\nSaham! It's not gonna be worth it!
Please! Our lives are at stake!
YOU IDIOT!!\nCan't you at least consider what I said?!
I appreciate it.\nIt's prolly gonna be a long journey from here.\nTake this item. Please make good use of it.
Hmm...\nIt's much better than walking back there.\nBut don't forget I'm carrying your baggage!
If you ignore me next time, I'll run away with\nyour baggage! I'm serious, you know?!
Oh, hold on.\nI've got something good for the lady too.
Really?!
Balsette gave you a package.
Huh? What's inside?
Secret. It's a quite rare thing, you know...\nOooh, no. Don't unpack it now.
Oh, it's a reward, so please open it after you\nget the detox gems. Promise me.
Eh heh heh. Alright!
How can I get angry after this!
Hey, what are you doing? Come on.
The detox gem is a kind of holy gem, right?\nI guess Nelfon might be able to create it at the\nmanor.
If he can create it, we don't need to go to Saham\nand we can save the item, right?
Go to Saham Crater
Go to Figo's Manor
Hmm... Well, yea.\nThere's no doubt Naiata can create it...\nOkay. Let's just teleport. Hurry, hurry!
Oh, you are back safe. Thanks...
Damn you wanderer!\nHow could you deceive me?!
What? I didn't deceive you.\nIt's rare and useful, isn't it?
And did I say it's a treasure?\nI said it was a reward for you, right?
Um... T-That might be true but...\nUgg... I... I just can't accept it!!
You gave Detox Gem to Balsette!
Wow! That's what we needed!\nNow we can cure the poison.\nLet's use it right now...
Amazing!\nBut it doesn't seem to be only the effect of\nthe gem...
It's the gem's effect.\nIt works extremely well.\nThe creator must be pretty skilled.
You brought the gems for us?\nWe would have been taken down by the monsters\nor the poison without your help.
You might not like it but...\nLet me escort you to the Lost Town ahead\nin return.
Sure, thanks.
No, thank you.
Okay. Let's go.
Leader! A large number of monsters are\ncoming to the fortress!!
What?!\nHuh, they don't give us time to prepare...
...What? No need to escort?\nBut um... Right.\nWe need to secure the fortress...
I got it. Be careful on your way.
But I must do something for you...\nHmm...It's true that we've just recovered.\nBut it's not really far so...
Leader! A large number of monsters are\ncoming to the fortress!!
What?!
...Looks like I had better listen to you.
Go ahead then.\nWatch your steps.
Soldiers! Prepare for the battle!!
Hi there!\nThanks for helping us last time.
Leader, the adventurers came here.
Oh, nice to see you again!\nThe monsters never stop attacking us but make\nyourself at home.
Hey, it doesn't feel like a god or goddess\nis near here...
You asked Rieno if he saw a god or goddess here...
What?!\nWe wouldn't be attacked like this if a god was\nnear here. Right? Balsette?
We never know.\nHe might be watching us from somewhere\nto see whether we can overcome the trial.
Ha ha, I wouldn't like such a mischievous god...
Leader! A large number of monsters are\ncoming to the fortress!!
What?!
Leader!\nWe need to form a defense line!
I'm sorry but please give us a hand!
I want you to fight the monsters near the\nhalf-broken fence.
Phew, we made it.
Yea...
You've been a great help to us...\nHm? What's that?
T-That's…
How beautiful...\nIt's amazing...
The sorcery gem was completed before you notice!
A god might have been around here indeed.\nI think he saw your great efforts and bestow\nhis power upon the sorcery gem...
Even a god would praise your effort just now.\nYou should be proud of it.
By the way, where are you going next...\nWhat?! The Gate of Another World?!\nBut it's too dangerous... Hmm... I see.
You stopped by here in order to get to the gate...\nThen, I can't stop you...
I hope you come back safe.\nMay the divine energy in the sorcery gem protect\nyou...
...Wait. Did you show him the sorcery gem\nor tell him about it?
That's strange.\nHe looked like he knew about the sorcery gem...
Well, forget it!\nYou must have told him by chance or something.\nThink before you speak, okay?
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat All the Gob Rogas!!
